title: Provincial Capital
description: San Jose de Buenavista serves as the administrative, educational, and commercial center of Antique Province.

title: Evelio Javier Freedom Park
description: Located at the heart of the town, honoring former Governor Evelio B. Javier and standing as a landmark of democracy and civic pride.

title: Tiringbanay Festival
description: Celebrated annually every May, bringing together communities for cultural performances, trade fairs, and historical commemoration.

title: Coastal Heritage
description: Blessed with scenic sunsets along Funda-Dalipe and vibrant coastal fisheries along the Sulu Sea shoreline.
